## Setup and configuration

- Checks and status page settings: [.upptimerc.yml](./.upptimerc.yml)
- The public page (plain HTML, CSS and JS, no build step): [site/](./site/). Deployed by [pages.yml](./.github/workflows/pages.yml). To preview it locally run `python3 -m http.server -d site 8123` and open `http://localhost:8123/?mock=outage` (also `ok`, `degraded`; the fixtures are in `site/mock.js`, which is only used on localhost and is not deployed)
- Files under `history/`, `api/` and `graphs/` and the workflows other than `pages.yml` are generated by Upptime; do not edit them by hand.
- Upptime's own status site is turned off (`skipGeneratingWebsite` in `.upptimerc.yml`). The page loads `history/summary.json` and the `status` issues in the browser. Incident updates are comments on the issue, starting with `Identified:`, `Monitoring:`, `Update:` or `Resolved:`.
